## Pass 1 — findings refused (kept as drafted)

- Person shift in the oath formulae (units 1, 7, 8: ይትኀየልኪ, ኢያምሕለኪ, ኢይትኀየል read as 'I'): the drafter's reading is the only workable one and is flagged; no better parse found. Kept.
- ባሕርያተ 'pearls (?)' (unit 15): Dillmann has ባሕርይ also as 'pearl'; fits (ብሩሃተ, likenesses of sun, moon, stars). Kept with (?).
- መቅለድ / መቃልድ 'jar (?)': Dillmann's main sense is 'key' (cf. Arabic maqālīd); 'key' does not fit 'water of the ...' and 'wash the ...'. Left as the drafter's flagged guess.
- ሲሕ 'thousand (?)': no better candidate by memory; flagged already.
- ያስተሓይጽ / አስተሓየጸት 'peer (?)', አርመስመሰት 'grew rough (?)', ዮጊኬ 'then (?)', ዘትካት, አብትር: cannot be improved from memory; kept flagged.
- ወትበ / ወትበሎ read as ወትቤ: kept, flagged.
- ዓዲሁ 'still': fine.
